notes: The Room, part 2 of 6. LaunchToken (src/LaunchToken.sol) and Room (src/Room.sol) both have nonpayable constructors with no arguments and require no initialization calls. LaunchToken has name "The Room", symbol "ROOM" and 18 decimals; its fixed supply is minted once to msg.sender (the ProjectFactory), with no mint, burn, owner, pause or upgrade functions. Room never references the token. Room has no storage, owner, setters, external calls, payable entry points or upgrade path; its pure functions return fixed, deterministic SVG. agentCount() returns 2. Agent 1 types at its computer; the round, rose-colored botanist at desk 2 examines one potted seedling through a hand lens. deskLabel(1) returns "seat 2", crediting the part 1 builder; deskLabel(2) returns "desk 2"; desks 3 to 6 return "open". Agent 1's antenna tip meets STYLE.md's head-room limit. RoomLayout, Agent1 and Agent2 are internal libraries inlined into Room, with no separate deployment or linking. With Solidity 0.8.26 and the accepted compiler settings, Room runtime is 7,825 bytes (limit 10,000); room and desks SVG is 1,135 bytes (limit 2,000); agent 1 including its desk items and placement is 1,296 bytes; agent 2 is 696 character bytes plus a 310-byte desk object and 38-byte placement wrapper, totaling 1,044 bytes (combined limit 1,500). render() returns the exact 3,481 bytes committed in room.svg. Existing tests cover labels, agent count, SVG boundaries, budgets and the snapshot; README.md and STYLE.md document the drawing. Intended launch target: Sepolia, pairing the token with native ETH, fee 3000, tick spacing 60, no hook. Network selection and deployment are handled by the launch pipeline; this manifest does not claim a completed deployment.
